working_definition: L2 is lamina monopolar neuron 2, a columnar interneuron of the lamina and the main input to the OFF-motion pathway, carrying photoreceptor signal from lamina to medulla. It was resolved by regression-model similarity to the Tan et al. (2015) L2 bulk transcriptome (not a single literature marker), with axon terminals in medulla OFF-pathway input layers synapsing onto Tm1 and Tm2.

best_match.fbbt_definition: A lamina monopolar neuron with short collaterals that project radially from the main projection in the lamina and that arborizes in medulla layer M2. In the lamina it receives strong input from photoreceptors R1-R6 (Rivera-Alba et al., 2011). It has both pre- and postsynaptic connections in medulla layer M2, with strong synaptic input coming from centrifugal neurons C2 and C3 (Takemura et al., 2013). It has a large number of presynaptic connections to lamina monopolar neuron L5, columnar neuron T1, and transmedullary neurons Tm1, Tm2 and Tm4 (Takemura et al., 2013). It is a cholinergic neuron (Takemura et al., 2011) and is electrically synapsed to lamina monopolar neuron L1 (Joesch et al., 2010). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).

justification: FBbt:00003720 is postsynaptic to R1-R6 in the lamina and presynaptic to Tm1/Tm2 in medulla layer M2, exactly the OFF-pathway relay role described in the report. This is an adult brain atlas and L2 is a well-established, singular cell type, not merged with any other type in this cluster, so the mature adult term is the correct level (no separate adult-specific variant exists beyond this term; the immature form would only apply to a developing/pupal atlas). The report's caveat that the L2 call rests on regression-model similarity rather than a literature marker, with only parent-cluster (undifferentiated) marker evidence in Table S3, affects confidence in the subclustering call but not the anatomical identity of the FBbt term itself, which is anatomically uncontroversial as stated in the report's own mapping notes.
recommendation: Accept as exact match at high confidence.
